topbar.tagline: Crystal Clear Naturally Water — Jaldoot Ltd.

tlab.sub: Ultrasonic, magnetic static, pulsing power and catalytic technology working together. No chemicals. No salt. No maintenance.

why.text: Jaldoot has spent more than a decade engineering water-conditioning hardware that installers trust on farms, factories and homes. Every unit runs on four technologies working together - ultrasonic, magnetic static, pulsing power and catalytic - so the result is measurable, chemical-free and consistent from one building to the next.

split.text: Watch Jaldoot turn hard, scale-laden water into soft, crystal-clear water — with ultrasonic, magnetic static, pulsing power and catalytic technology working together. No chemicals. No salt. No maintenance.
split.point2: Works on homes, farms and factories

benefits.lead: Hover, tap or tab any card to flip it and see what sits behind the claim.

card1.title: Maintenance-free
card1.desc: Eco-friendly solution against scale problems, with no backwashing and no moving parts.
card1.backDesc: No impeller, no seal, no filter bed. Fit the unit and leave it running.

card2.title: No chemicals, no salts
card2.desc: No chemicals, no salts & additives anywhere in the process.
card2.backDesc: Nothing to top up, nothing to buy, no taste or chemistry change in the water.

card3.title: Easy installation
card3.desc: No replacement required. Movable product — take it with you when you want.
card3.backDesc: Fit it around the existing pipe in minutes — no cutting, no plumbing changes.

card4.title: Works on every pipe
card4.desc: Effective on CPVC, RPVC, UPVC, HDPE, copper, brass, SS 304 and SS 316.
card4.backDesc: Thermoplastics, copper, brass and stainless steel — the field does not care what it is clamped to.

card5.title: Wide size range
card5.desc: Suitable for pipe diameters from 1′ up to 20′ or 6′ depending on the model.
card5.backDesc: Pick the model that matches the line you already have instead of re-piping.

card6.title: Models for varied work
card6.desc: Our product models represent on varied work across industries.
card6.backDesc: One product family, tuned models for domestic lines, agriculture and industrial duty.

sustainability.sub: Jaldoot conditions hard water without chemicals, salt or power, so homes, farms and factories use less water, less energy and throw away less.

card1.name: No Chemical Dosing
card1.desc: No chlorine, acid or salt — hard water is conditioned physically, not dosed with chemicals.

card2.name: Zero Salt Waste
card2.desc: No brine, no regeneration cycle and no bag of salt to dispose of every month.

card3.name: No Power Required
card3.desc: Runs on the pressure already in your line, so there are no pumps to power or service.

card4.name: Longer Equipment Life
card4.desc: Fewer scale build-ups mean longer-lasting taps, boilers and pipelines.

intro.lede: Jaldoot Water Conditioner / Softener is an advanced water treatment system combining Ultrasonic + Magnetic Static + Pulsing Power + Catalytic Technology, controlled by a microprocessor — treating hard water without chemicals, salt, or maintenance.

benefit1.title: No Chemicals
benefit1.desc: Works without any chemicals, salt, or consumables — completely natural water treatment.

benefit2.title: Zero Maintenance
benefit2.desc: Install once and forget — no filters to change, no salt to add, no recurring maintenance costs.

benefit3.title: Scale Reduction
benefit3.desc: Converts hard scale-forming minerals into harmless 2–4 micron crystals that don't stick to surfaces.

benefit4.title: Long-Lasting Effect
benefit4.desc: Treated water retains its conditioned properties for up to 7 days as stated by the company.

howitworks.text: Jaldoot uses a 3-stage water conditioning process combining advanced technologies
howitworks.videoCaption2: See the 3-stage conditioning process in action

applications.text: From homes to farms to factories — Jaldoot serves every water need

card1.title: Domestic
card1.desc: Complete home water treatment — kitchen, bathroom, geysers, washing machines, plumbing systems.

card2.title: Agriculture
card2.desc: Agriculture, horticulture, floriculture & irrigation — improved crop yield and soil health.

card3.title: Commercial
card3.desc: Hotels, restaurants, hospitals, laundries, cooling towers & commercial water systems.

card4.title: Industrial
card4.desc: RO plants, boilers, cooling systems, heat exchangers & manufacturing processes.

card5.title: Poultry Farming
card5.desc: Better water quality for improved bird health and production.

card6.title: Dairy Farming
card6.desc: Clean conditioned water for dairy operations and equipment.

card7.title: Swimming Pools
card7.desc: Reduced chemicals, less scale, cleaner and softer pool water.

card8.title: Golf & Fish Ponds
card8.desc: Conditioned water for greens, fairways and fish ponds — cleaner water and controlled algae.

card9.title: ETP Plant – Effluent Treatment Plant
card9.desc: Treat trade effluent at the source — stops scale in tanks, pumps and membranes, and lowers chemical dosing.

card10.title: STP – Sewage Treatment Plant
card10.desc: Condition sewage inlet water, reduce scaling in aeration tanks and improve biological treatment efficiency.

card11.title: Rain Water Harvesting
card11.desc: Keep harvested rainwater scale-free for storage, recharge pits and reuse across the property.

card12.title: Solar Roof Top
card12.desc: Protect rooftop solar tanks and piping from hard water scale and efficiency loss.

card13.title: Solar Water Heater
card13.desc: Prevent scale on heater elements and tanks — faster hot water, lower power bills, longer life.

card14.title: Solar Insect Cleaner
card14.desc: Scale-free water for solar-powered insect control and agricultural spray systems.
